source.rules: Every fact was read on the provider's own page on the entry's checked_on date, and source_urls says which page. A fact that could not be confirmed is unknown, not guessed. Free allowances change often: re-read the source page before relying on a number.

ai_services.name: Cerebras

read_remaining.note: Quota replenishes continuously rather than at fixed times. The rate-limits page does not mention headers that report what is left.

title.en: Sign up or log in to Cerebras Cloud

detail.en: Muse opens cloud.cerebras.ai. Sign up or log in there.
detail.zh-TW: Muse 會打開 cloud.cerebras.ai。請在那裡註冊或登入。

title.en: Open API Keys and create a key
title.zh-TW: 打開 API Keys 並建立金鑰

detail.en: Choose API Keys in the left menu and create a key. Muse does not click anything for you.
detail.zh-TW: 在左側選單選 API Keys，然後建立一組金鑰。Muse 不會替你點擊任何東西。

detail.en: Copy it, then come back here and paste it when asked.
detail.zh-TW: 複製後回到這裡，等 Muse 詢問時貼上。

policy.note: Training and review terms for the API were not confirmed, so the private class skips it. The website terms say Cerebras's right to monitor content does not give it the right to train on it; the pricing page footnote says the free offer is not intended for production use.

models.notes: Free-trial model on the rate-limits page. 131,072 context from the LiteLLM map, so not in long-context.
Free-trial model on the rate-limits page and the quickstart. 65,536 context from the LiteLLM map.

ai_services.notes: Cerebras Inference free trial. Limits are per model and were read from the rate-limits page on 2026-11-12 (gpt-oss-120b and qwen-3.8-27b: 5 requests a minute, 1M tokens a day). LiteLLM 1.108.5 routes cerebras/<model> to https://api.cerebras.ai/v1 and has both models in its price map. Context windows come from that map.

ai_services.name: Cloudflare Workers AI

limits.scope: all Workers AI models, free plan

read_remaining.note: The pricing page says limits reset at 00:00 UTC and that requests fail once the free amount is used. It does not say how to read what is left.

title.en: Sign up or log in to Cloudflare

detail.en: Muse opens dash.cloudflare.com. Sign up or log in there.
detail.zh-TW: Muse 會打開 dash.cloudflare.com。請在那裡註冊或登入。

title.zh-TW: 複製你的帳號 ID（Account ID）

detail.en: Open the Workers AI page, choose Use REST API, and copy the Account ID. Come back here and paste it when asked.
detail.zh-TW: 打開 Workers AI 頁面，選「Use REST API」，複製 Account ID。回到這裡，等 Muse 詢問時貼上。

title.en: Create a Workers AI API token
title.zh-TW: 建立 Workers AI API 權杖

detail.en: On the same page choose Create a Workers AI API Token, review the prefilled details and create it. Muse does not click anything for you.
detail.zh-TW: 在同一頁選「Create a Workers AI API Token」，確認預填內容後建立。Muse 不會替你點擊任何東西。

detail.en: Copy the token, then come back here and paste it when asked.
detail.zh-TW: 複製權杖，再回到這裡，等 Muse 詢問時貼上。

policy.note: Cloudflare says it does not use Customer Content processed by Workers AI to train models, and does not keep inputs or outputs of plain inference requests. Human review is not addressed, so the private class still skips it.

models.notes: Small Llama. The neurons one request costs depend on the model; this one is the cheapest of the two.
Larger Llama. Uses the free neurons faster than the 8B model. 24,000 context from the LiteLLM map.

ai_services.notes: Workers AI free plan: 10,000 neurons a day, reset at 00:00 UTC (pricing page, 2026-11-12). LiteLLM 1.108.5 routes cloudflare/<@cf model> to https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<account id>/ai/v1 and reads the account id from CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, so the provider needs both variables (also_env). Model ids are on the Workers AI models page. Context windows come from the LiteLLM price map, not from Cloudflare.

ai_services.name: Cohere

read_remaining.note: The rate-limits page does not say how the monthly limit resets or how to read what is left.

title.zh-TW: 打開 Cohere 的金鑰頁面

detail.en: Muse opens dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys. Sign in, or sign up there if you do not have an account yet.
detail.zh-TW: Muse 會打開 dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys。請在那裡登入；還沒有帳號的話就先註冊。

detail.zh-TW: 試用金鑰免費，但有次數限制。請在該頁面找到你的試用金鑰。

detail.en: Copy it, then come back here and paste it when asked.
detail.zh-TW: 複製後回到這裡，等 Muse 詢問時貼上。

policy.note: Trial keys are not permitted for production or commercial use (1,000 calls a month). One account only. The 2022 Terms of Use are written for business use and exclude personal or household purposes; read them before relying on a trial key.

models.notes: Command A, 256k context. command-a-plus-05-2026 is newer but the models page lists it at 128k, so it is not the long-context pick.
Small Command model, 128k context, 4k max output on the models page.
Default output dimension on the models page is 2048, with 256/512/768/1024/1536/2048 available. Do not mix these vectors with Gemini or Jina vectors.
Live on the models page (32k). Cohere recommends rerank-v5.0-fast for new projects; that id is not in the LiteLLM 1.108.5 price map, so v4.0-fast is what the proxy is configured to call.

ai_services.notes: Trial keys are free and, per Cohere's rate-limit docs, capped at 1,000 calls per month. Chat is additionally about 20 requests per minute. Order 2 so Gemini and Groq absorb traffic first.

title.zh-TW: 建立 LINE 官方帳號

detail.en: Register for a LINE Business ID with your LINE account or an email address, then fill in the form for a LINE Official Account.
detail.zh-TW: 用你的 LINE 帳號或電子郵件註冊 LINE Business ID，再填寫建立 LINE 官方帳號的表單。

detail.en: In LINE Official Account Manager, enable the Messaging API for the account and choose a provider. The provider cannot be changed afterwards.
detail.zh-TW: 在 LINE Official Account Manager 為該帳號啟用 Messaging API，並選擇一個 provider。選定後就不能更改。

title.en: Check the channel in the LINE Developers Console
title.zh-TW: 在 LINE Developers Console 確認頻道

detail.en: Log in to the LINE Developers Console with the same account and check that a Messaging API channel now exists under that provider.
detail.zh-TW: 用同一個帳號登入 LINE Developers Console，確認該 provider 底下已經有一個 Messaging API 頻道。

how.en: Needs your own LINE Official Account with the Messaging API switched on. Muse does not connect to it yet.
how.zh-TW: 需要你自己的 LINE 官方帳號，並啟用 Messaging API。Muse 目前還不會連接它。

other_allowances.notes: Read on 2026-11-13. LINE Developers "Messaging API pricing": reply messages are not counted towards the plan's message count; push, multicast, broadcast and narrowcast messages are. A message is counted once per person it is sent to, whatever the number of message objects, and not at all if the person blocked the account. Over the limit, the API returns an error and the message is not sent. The plan table on that page is Japan's; plans differ by country. LINE Biz-Solutions Taiwan, "2026年 LINE 官方帳號方案價格調整" (dated 2026-09-01): the price plan took effect on 2026-11-01; the light plan stays at NT$0 with 200 free messages a month and cannot buy more; the medium plan is NT$1,000 for 3,000 and the high plan NT$1,400 for 6,000 (prices before tax). The same page lists the Messaging API's Reply API, one-to-one chat, auto-replies and the welcome message as free of charge. Messaging API channels can no longer be created directly in the LINE Developers Console (since 2024-09-04); they are created by enabling the Messaging API on an Official Account. Not confirmed: whether a card or a phone number is needed, and LINE's terms on automation and reselling.
